WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage_pct,
         COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(telescope_count * 1.0) AS avg_telescope_count
  FROM station_stats
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.avg_bandusage_pct,
       s.telescope_count,
       s.telescope_count / a.avg_telescope_count AS telescope_ratio
FROM station_stats s
CROSS JOIN avg_count a
ORDER BY telescope_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
